penjualan_batal_check.name: penjualan_batal_check
penjualan_batal_check.value: "penjualan"."status" <> 'batal' OR ("penjualan"."alasan_batal" IS NOT NULL AND "penjualan"."dibatalkan_oleh" IS NOT NULL AND "penjualan"."dibatalkan_pada" IS NOT NULL)

pre_order_batal_check.name: pre_order_batal_check
pre_order_batal_check.value: "pre_order"."status" <> 'batal' OR ("pre_order"."alasan_batal" IS NOT NULL AND "pre_order"."dibatalkan_pada" IS NOT NULL)

resep_adonan_loyang_check.name: resep_adonan_loyang_check
resep_adonan_loyang_check.value:
("resep_adonan"."bentuk_loyang" IS NULL)
        OR ("resep_adonan"."bentuk_loyang" = 'bulat' AND "resep_adonan"."diameter_cm" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("resep_adonan"."bentuk_loyang" = 'kotak' AND "resep_adonan"."panjang_cm" IS NOT NULL AND "resep_adonan"."lebar_cm" IS NOT NULL)
